integrity: The inverse formulas and regular-norm upper bounds were taken from the open-access focal preprint. Ordinary operator-norm lower bounds were reconstructed from explicit finitely supported alternating-sign inputs and geometric-series limits, then the parameter minima were checked algebraically. No independent validation or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The claim is only about the two elementary sequence-space isomorphisms in Proposition 3.1 of arXiv:2609.14148v1. It does not prove optimality of the final global positive-Miljutin distortion constant or classify all positive isomorphisms. Because the sign-alignment lower bounds are short, an equivalent exactness observation may exist under other notation despite targeted searches.
title: Exact inverse regular norms for the elementary positive Miljutin maps
